list: The official 55 trophies, as published on PlayStation (names, descriptions and grades as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles, 2026-11-18). GTA VI released 2026-11-19, so no verified external step-by-step guide exists yet; every guide below is written from the official description alone and says so.
sourceNote: Source for every trophy: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description. No specific locations, NPCs, coordinates or step sequences are claimed anywhere in this guide, because none has been verified.

trophies.guide: This is the platinum: it unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is nothing to do for it directly. Work through the roadmap in this guide — story first, then the counted activities and collectibles, with 100% completion last — and this trophy follows on its own. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing — the first story mission of the game, so it comes naturally at the very start. It is a story trophy, awarded on completion, and cannot be missed: just play the opening mission through to its end. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its final mission and the trophy unlocks when the chapter closes. Story chapters award their trophy on completion, so there is no way to miss this — keep following the story missions in order. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.guide: Complete every story mission of Chapter 2 and the trophy is yours when the chapter ends. Like all chapter trophies it is awarded on completion and cannot be missed; if you are unsure where you stand, the chapter closes only after its last mission, so keep playing the story. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 in full. This is a story-completion trophy: it unlocks when the chapter's final mission is done, and no side activity is needed for it. Use the time in this chapter to start chipping at the counted activities — races, stunts and exploration — since they carry over. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4, the last chapter before the finale. The trophy unlocks on the chapter's completion, so it cannot be missed. Before moving on to the final mission, it is a good moment to clear any open side strands, since the endgame is where the remaining counted trophies are easiest to mop up. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.guide: Finish the game's final mission to earn this gold trophy. It is the story's endpoint, awarded on completion, and cannot be missed — but the platinum still needs the 100% completion trophy afterwards, so treat the finale as the start of the cleanup phase, not the end of the hunt. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Mission trophies unlock when that mission is finished, so this one is unmissable — it comes as you play the story in order. No preparation is needed; just complete the mission's objectives. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. As a named-mission trophy it unlocks on finishing that mission, so it cannot be missed. Heist missions tend to be longer, so go in with the mission's own objectives in mind and finish it in one run. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Mission trophies are awarded on completion and cannot be missed — finish the mission and this unlocks. If it does not pop, the mission itself is not yet finished. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Like every named-mission trophy, it unlocks when the mission ends and cannot be missed. Just play the mission through to completion. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set around the Vice City airport. It is a mission-completion trophy and cannot be missed. Expect an action-heavy mission given the name; finish its objectives and the trophy follows. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Mission trophies unlock on completion and cannot be missed, so play the mission through. The name suggests a large set-piece mission; take it at the pace the mission sets. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the game's own completion checklist — the last gold before the platinum. This is a long-haul trophy: it counts story, side strands, activities and collectibles together, so it should come last, after every other trophy is done. Track your progress here in this guide and use the in-game completion stat to find what is left. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts in total — the count is cumulative across the whole game, so every jump, near-miss and airtime moment adds up. The practical approach is to let the count grow naturally while playing, then grind the remainder late in the game by chaining stunt jumps and airtime in a fast vehicle. Nothing about the description suggests a one-time window, so it can be finished at any point after stunts unlock. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — the game tracks 9 activity types, and one attempt at each is enough; you do not need to win or master any of them. Sample activities as they unlock during the story (races, shooting range, fishing, arcade, bowling, drone races and the rest) and this pops early. It cannot be missed: activities stay available after they unlock. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges — the game's largest single counted grind in this list, and a silver for good reason. Approach it in sessions: learn one challenge's target pattern, repeat it until gold, then move on. Challenges can be retried as often as needed, so nothing is missable; prioritise accuracy over speed, since a gold medal is about the score threshold, not finishing first. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. Each location is a separate race to win, so work through them one at a time and retry any you lose — races can be replayed, so no win is missable. Learn each course's turns before pushing for the win, and keep a note here of which locations are already done. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different races, so repeating the same one does not count twice. Enter the race types as they unlock (road races, drone races and any others the game offers) and spread your wins across them. Races are replayable, so this can be finished any time after racing unlocks; it pairs well with the drone-race trophy. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge — a head-to-head fishing contest, so the goal is to out-fish one rival, not to catch everything. Take the challenge when fishing is available, focus on steady catches rather than risky ones, and retry if Cal wins: challenges like this can be attempted again, so the trophy is not missable. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — finish a single game at an arcade, whichever one you like best. This is one of the easiest trophies: find an arcade once they are open to you, pick a game and play it to its end. It stays available, so it cannot be missed. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Andy's strand of side missions. Contact strands unlock through the story and build to a final mission; finish that last mission and the trophy unlocks. Side-mission strands stay available once unlocked, so this is not missable — follow Andy's missions whenever they appear. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Kenton's strand. Like the other contact strands, it ends with a final mission that awards the trophy on completion. Keep taking Kenton's missions as they come up; the strand remains open once unlocked, so it cannot be missed. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Billy's strand. The trophy is awarded when that last mission ends, so play Billy's missions through in order. Strands stay available after they unlock, so there is no missable window — just finish the strand. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida — whole strands, not single missions, so each one takes several missions to finish. Stranger encounters appear across the map as you explore; take each strand to its end before moving on, and track the finished ones here. Strands remain available once found, so this is a patience trophy, not a missable one. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Randy's strand. Finish Randy's missions in order until the strand's last mission, which awards the trophy on completion. The strand stays open once unlocked, so it cannot be missed. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Tyrone's strand. As with the other contact strands, play Tyrone's missions through to the final one; the trophy unlocks when it ends and the strand cannot be missed once it is open. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Treat it as a collectible hunt: visit spots as you explore new areas and tick them off here, so you can see which regions are still open. Spots stay in the world once you can reach them, so none is missable. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — a single named hunt, not general hunting. Take Bret's hunt when it is offered and follow the hunt itself rather than wandering: the trophy is about that one animal. Hunts can be retried if they go wrong, so the description gives no reason to call it missable. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets — whole sets, so collecting a few cards is not enough; each set must be finished. Cards are a world collectible, so pick up every card you pass while exploring and finish sets one at a time. Collectibles persist in the world, so sets can be completed at any point and nothing is missable. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations — a cumulative count, so every new location adds one. Make a habit of it whenever you reach a fresh spot rather than saving it for the end; the count builds up across normal play and the last stretch is a sweep of places you have not tried yet. Locations stay available, so it cannot be missed. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges in total, across whatever challenge types the game offers. This is a volume trophy that grows alongside everything else you do — stunts, races, shooting and more all feed it. Check the in-game challenge list regularly and finish the easy ones first; the count is cumulative and never locks out. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it and escape. The key is the partner: do it during a mission or activity where your partner is with you, raise the heat to 4 stars, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear. If you are caught or the stars drop early, just try again — wanted levels can be raised any time, so it is not missable. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, without losing your wanted level between them — the streak is the whole challenge, so the wanted level must survive all three robberies. Plan a route of three close shops, keep your partner with you, move fast between them and avoid anything that would clear the heat early. A failed run costs nothing but the attempt: retry it until the streak holds. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — variety is what counts, so drive something new whenever you see it rather than sticking to one favourite. Vehicles are discovered by getting into them, so hop into every unfamiliar car, bike and truck you pass. The count is cumulative across the game and vehicles keep appearing, so it cannot be missed. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus — all five inside the same activation, so set it up first. Wait for a fight with a cluster of enemies, trigger Combat Focus when several are in view, and take them down before it ends. Combat encounters repeat throughout the game, so a failed attempt is just a retry. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — the Vice City airport. The description asks for a departure nobody scheduled, so get yourself airside at the airport and leave by air on your own terms rather than by a booked flight. The airport stays open to you, so the trophy can be attempted any time and is not missable. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.guide: The description is a joke about Rhinos — the tank — so this trophy involves the Rhino tank in some way, most likely getting into one or surviving its heat. The official description alone does not spell out the exact trigger, and no verified guide exists yet, so the honest advice is: once Rhinos appear in your game, engage with one and watch what the game counts; the trophy's own wording points at the tank itself. Do not trust any unverified step list for this one yet. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — stealth is the requirement, so plan the robbery rather than rushing it. Go in quietly, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, take what you came for and leave before any alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails but the store can be robbed again, so it is not missable. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape from each — five separate vault robberies, each ending in a clean escape. Plan each one (entry, vault, getaway) and do not rush the escape, since the trophy needs the escape as well as the robbery. Vaults can be attempted again after a failure, so work through all five at your own pace. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob one armored truck and escape afterwards. Armored trucks travel the roads of Leonida, so find one on the move, stop it, take its cargo and get clear before the response arrives. Trucks keep appearing, so a failed attempt is just a retry — this is not missable. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — the whole map, area by area, until every named place has been visited. The practical approach is to sweep region by region as the story opens them up, using this guide's checklist to remember what is left. Areas never close, so exploration can be finished at any time after the map is open. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — one per gang, so you need to find all nine gangs' operations across Leonida. Work through the gangs one at a time and tick them off here as you go. Operations stay in the world, so this is a completion sweep, not a missable one. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — a quiet moment trophy, not a challenge. Head to Ocean Beach, find a spot with a view over the water, and have a cocktail there. It is available whenever you can reach the beach, so it cannot be missed; a nice one to do early for an easy bronze. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight out through the showroom's glass, in the spirit of the classic scene the description nods to. Pick a showroom, get a car inside or lined up at it, and drive out through the front. Showrooms stay open, so retry until it pops; it is not missable. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — go bowling there and complete a game, following through on your throws. This is a simple activity trophy: visit that alley once bowling is available to you and play a full game. It stays available, so it cannot be missed. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.guide: The description is deliberately vague — a partnership with mass appeal — and no verified guide exists yet, so this one cannot be given a specific method honestly. What the wording points to is a partnership moment that draws a crowd: play the story and the partner activities, and watch for a moment where the partnership is on public display. Revisit this guide's note once verified details appear; do not trust an unsourced step list. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse — this trophy tracks the choices you make in the game, and PlayStation counts them up to 500. The approach is simple: keep playing and keep choosing; every decision adds to the count. There is no single moment to hit, and choices keep coming through the story, so it cannot be missed. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — this trophy is about succeeding on a second attempt at something, so it almost certainly pops the second time you retry an activity you first failed. The honest reading of the description is: fail something once, then succeed at it on the next try. Play normally and it should come on its own; if it has not by the endgame, retry any activity you failed earlier. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? — the description reads like a reaction to something strange, so this is most likely tied to an unusual world event or encounter in Leonida. No verified account of the trigger exists yet, so the honest advice is to explore widely, investigate anything odd you stumble across, and keep this trophy in mind while roaming. Do not follow an unsourced claim about where it happens. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, like bowling a strike. Line up a slow pass past a target, swing the melee weapon as you drive by, and keep the speed low enough to aim. Drive-bys can be attempted anywhere there are people on foot, so retry until it lands; it is not missable. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts — a cumulative money total, so every laundered bill adds up. Use your contacts to launder bills whenever you have them, and the total grows across the whole game. There is no time limit in the description, so keep laundering as bills come in and this pops in due course. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — cumulative spending, so every purchase in any shop counts toward the same total. Buy gear, clothes, weapons and upgrades as you play and the total climbs on its own; if it is still short in the endgame, spend the surplus on expensive items. Shops never close, so it cannot be missed. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties — every garage the game offers, so save up and buy them as they become available. Garages are also useful storage, so buy them when you can afford them rather than leaving them all to the end. Properties stay for sale, so none is missable. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — ten different vehicles, registered through the app. Whenever you find a vehicle worth keeping, register it; the count is cumulative, so it builds up alongside the 100-vehicle discovery trophy. The app stays available, so this cannot be missed. (Source: official trophy description via Exophase.)
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.source: Exophase – Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN); official trophy description
